page7_img_1.png.title: Pull-quote panel emphasizing maintainability over bug-finding in code reviews
page7_img_1.png.description: A decorative pull-out panel (originally an orange-bordered, beige box) that highlights a key takeaway from the article: although people associate code reviews with finding bugs, the more important outcome is improved long-term maintainability. The panel reiterates the paper’s finding that only a small fraction of review comments relate to defects (the text elsewhere reports ~15%) while a much larger share address maintainability, style, documentation and API usage. In the supplied extraction most of the panel’s text is not rendered (the image shows large white space and a dotted vertical rule at the right edge), but its role in the layout is to call attention to this counterintuitive result for readers.
